project.title: Transducing paths in graph classes with unbounded shrubdepth
project.lead_organization: Centre d'Analyse et de Mathématiques Sociales (CNRS, UMR 8557)
project.funding: grant ERCCZ LL-2105, GAČR 22-06454S, European Research Council (ERC) grant agreement No. 803421, German Research Foundation (DFG) project SI 2445/1-1

Method.name: FO-transduction
Method.description: A general formalism for expressing transformations of graphs and relational structures in first-order logic.

Method.name: Shrubdepth
Method.description: A graph invariant defining structural complexity based on the height of trees from which a class can be transduced.

Method.name: Low-depth decomposition
Method.description: A graph-theoretic technique used to partition vertex sets into parts that induce simple structures like cographs.

Method.name: MSO-transduction
Method.description: A formalism for expressing graph transformations in monadic second-order logic.
